title: El Salvador’s Bukele seeks third term that could keep him in power until 2033
summary_full: After Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele’s allies changed his country’s constitution to allow him to remain in office, he has formalized plans to do so.
summary_public: After Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele’s allies changed his country’s constitution to allow him to remain in office, he has formalized plans to do so.
